lines.text: It's an AI media buyer that runs your ad campaigns for you. Here's how it works.
Step one. You set a daily budget, pick where your ads run, and choose a goal, like more sales.
Step two. The agent sets everything up. It studies your ad account's history, builds the campaign, and makes the ads.
Step three. It launches the campaign on its own.
Step four. It keeps checking the results on its own schedule, pauses what isn't working, and moves budget to what is.
And if it needs something only you know, it asks you.
[warm] Managed Campaigns. Your marketer, on autopilot.
